question: T10: one last score, what lights and what Link shows: fresh cases around the last refit, predictions pushed first in PRED-T10READS4.json
answer: Predictions pushed first (PRED-T10READS4.json), no refit after. 15 of 22 match. Misses: W10, where the oracle isn't dim and ours is; R1, R2 and R5, lit and the press opens the Add Link form, where ours shows an empty link row; R3, a bare bracket, lit with the form, ours not lit; R4, a reference with its definition, shows /x, ours an empty row; R8, a link inside two ticks, not lit with the form, ours lit showing /x. The first run was spoiled: after Escape, opening the panel again failed on every other case, so it was thrown away. This is the redo with --again: every state read first, then the Link press for R cases only. So W cases are scored on what lights and dims, with no Link press read. Together with CAP-T10SCORE.json: 29 of 39.
